tha-ap20:1.4: urūḷhavā setacchatto pasobhito sakappano → uruḷhavo setacchattopasedhito sāthabbaṇo (sya-all); urūḷhavo setacchattopasevito sāthabbaṇo (pts) | urūḷhavā → urūḷbhavo (bj: PTS)
tha-ap20:2.1: setacchattopasobhito → chattopasevito (bj: PTS, sī.selu); chatto sopadhiko (bj: machasaṁ, the) | Setacchattopasevito → Cy. reads setacchattopasobhito. (pts note) | sāthabbaṇo → G. sātabbaṇo and sādabbaṇo; Cy. sakappano. (pts note)
tha-ap20:2.2: sakappano → sādabbino (bj: machasaṁ); sīdabbano (bj: the) | sahatthipo → Cf. J. vi. 490. (pts note)
tha-ap20:3.2: kārayim → S1 M. kārayi'; kārayī. (pts note)
tha-ap20:3.3: mahoghadānaṁ → mahābhattaṁ (bj, pts) | mahābhattaṁ → mahoghañca (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu, a); mahaṅghañca (bj: the) | Mahoghadānaṁ → mahābhattaṁ (cck: sī.); mahoghañca (cck: ka.); mahādānaṁ (cck: ?) | mahābhattaṁ → G. S1 M. Cy. mahoghañ ca. (pts note)
tha-ap20:4.4: desesi → deseti (pts) | deseti → G. desesi. (pts note)
tha-ap20:5.2: jalajuttaranāmako → jaladuttamanāyako (sya-all, pts) | jalajuttaranāmako → jalajuttamanāyako (bj: PTS) | jaladuttamanāyako → G. jalajuttamanāyako; Cy. jalanuttama-, also jalajuttaranāmako. (pts note)
tha-ap20:6.2: kārayī → kārayi (sya-all) | kārayī ayaṁ → kārayiṁ ahaṁ (pts)
tha-ap20:7.3: byamhuttamamhi → vyamahuttamamhi (bj) | vyamhuttamamhi → G. brahmuttamamhi. (pts note)
tha-ap20:10.3: aḍḍhe → phīte (sya-all) | aḍḍhe → G. aḍḍhakule. (pts note)
tha-ap20:11.4: satthu sāvako padhānapahitatto → satthusāvako padhānaṁ pahitatto (sya-all)
tha-ap20:12.4: nibbāyissatināsavo → nibbāyissatanāsavo (bj, pts); nibbāyissatyanāsavo (sya-all) | anāsavo → G. nibbāyissati-. (pts note)
tha-ap20:13.2: jahitā → jahitvā (sya-all, pts) | jahitā → jahitvā (bj: machasaṁ, the, sī.selu)
tha-ap20:13.3: bhogamhi → bhogambhi (bj) | kheḷapiṇḍeva → kheḷapiṇḍo va (pts) | va → G. ti. (pts note)
